metadata.title: Austin Hooper - Hauls in touchdown pass in TNF win
metadata.description: Hooper caught both of his targets for 11 yards and a touchdown during Atlanta's 35-14 win over Green Bay on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Hooper was on the field for 16 of the Falcons' 71 offensive snaps, which was behind fellow tight ends Charlie Woerner (43), Kyle Pitts (42) and Nick Muse (17). However, unlike those three tight ends, Hooper contributed to the scoreboard by hauling in a five-yard touchdown pass from Michael Penix with just over a minute left to play in the second quarter. Hooper has a 4-31-1 receiving line (on six targets) through the first three games of the regular season.

metadata.title: Austin Hooper snags touchdown in win
metadata.description: Austin Hooper caught both of his targets for 11 yards and a score in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers.
metadata.analysis: Hooper had a touchdown grab early on in the game and didn't make much noise after that. He should be off fantasy radars as of right now.

metadata.title: Austin Hooper - Catches two targets in loss
metadata.description: Hooper caught two of his four targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 34-3 loss to the Panthers.
metadata.analysis: Hooper garnered significant attention for a No. 3 tight end. The 31-year-old saw the second-most targets for the Falcons, behind wide receiver Drake London. With Cooper Rush or Jack Strand at the helm of the offense, Hooper's large catch radius and vast experience in the NFL could keep netting him consistent attention and production.

metadata.title: Austin Hooper - Signing one-year deal with Falcons
metadata.description: Hooper agreed on a one-year, $3.25 million contract with the Falcons on Monday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
metadata.analysis: Hooper's signing is in line to become official Wednesday, when the new league year begins. The journeyman tight end spent his first four NFL seasons with the Falcons, who drafted him in the third round in 2016. Hooper has played for five NFL teams, most recently recording 21 catches for 263 yards and two touchdowns in 16 regular-season games with the Patriots in 2025. If the Falcons retain pending free agent Kyle Pitts as expected, Hooper would slot in as his top backup.

metadata.title: Austin Hooper returns to Atlanta Falcons
metadata.description: The Atlanta Falcons are bringing back veteran tight end Austin Hooper, who has spent the last two seasons in New England.
metadata.analysis: Hooper was drafted by the Falcons in 2016 and played 59 games in four seasons with the Falcons. Last season, he had 263 yards and two touchdowns with the Patriots, splitting time with Hunter Henry. He returns to Atlanta, where he was a two-time Pro Bowler, to play with Kyle Pitts Sr. on a one-year, $3.25 million deal.

metadata.title: Austin Hooper Heading Back to Atlanta
metadata.description: Free-agent tight end Austin Hooper is signing a one-year, $3.25 million deal with the Atlanta Falcons on Monday, according to Ian Rapoport of the NFL Network. Hooper was originally drafted by Atlanta in the third round in 2016 out of Stanford. The 31-year-old veteran spent the first four years of his NFL career with the Falcons and was a Pro Bowler with them in 2018 and 2019. He then bounced around with the Cleveland Browns, Tennessee Titans, Las Vegas Raiders, and New England Patriots. Hooper hasn't been as productive as he was in his final two seasons in Atlanta, and in his return, he'll be a backup to TE Kyle Pitts Sr. In 16 regular-season games (six starts) for the Patriots last year, Hooper had just 21 catches for 263 yards and two touchdowns. Unless Pitts is traded or injured in 2026, Hooper won't be on the fantasy radar in redraft leagues this fall.

metadata.title: Austin Hooper - Records 21 regular-season catches
metadata.description: Hooper finished the 2025 regular season with 21 catches (on 26 targets) for 263 yards and two TDs in 16 games.
metadata.analysis: While working behind fellow TE Hunter Henry (who logged a 60-768-7 receiving line) in a New England offense that spread the ball around, Hooper's fantasy impact this season was limited to deeper TE-friendly formats. The 31-year-old is eligible to become a free agent this coming offseason, unlike Henry, who is under contract with the Patriots through the 2026 campaign.

metadata.title: Austin Hooper - Scores TD in Week 17
metadata.description: Hooper caught both of his targets for 11 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 42-10 win over the Jets.
metadata.analysis: Per Mike Reiss of ESPN.com, Hooper logged 27 of 66 snaps on offense, while Hunter Henry saw 43 snaps and caught all three of his targets for 49 yards and a TD. As long as Henry remains healthy, Hooper -- who heads into Week 18 with a 20-258-3 receiving line in 15 games -- will be a TD-dependent dart throw in Week 18 against the Dolphins.

metadata.title: Austin Hooper finds the end zone in Week 17
metadata.description: Austin Hooper caught both of his targets for 11 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots 42-10 win over the Jets.
metadata.analysis: Hooper found the end zone on a two-yard reception to open the scoring against the Jets. Hooper continues to operate as the second tight end on the Patriots and should not be trusted by managers that have matchups in Week 18.

metadata.title: Austin Hooper - Two catches Sunday
metadata.description: Hooper caught two of his four targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 28-24 win over the Ravens.
metadata.analysis: Hooper was on the field for 23 of a possible 74 snaps on offense in the contest, per Mike Reiss of ESPN.com, while fellow TE Hunter Henry was out there for 60 en route to catching six of his seven targets for 35 yards and a TD. As this coming Sunday's game against the Jets approaches, Hooper profiles as a fantasy dart while working behind Henry in a New England offense that tends to spread the ball around.

metadata.title: Austin Hooper - Playing time dips Sunday
metadata.description: Hooper logged a season-low 16 out of a possible 52 snaps on offense in Sunday's 35-31 loss to the Bills, per Mike Reiss of ESPN.com.
metadata.analysis: For the second straight contest, Hooper saw a decrease in snaps and wasn't targeted in New England's passing game. He'll remain off the fantasy lineup radar as long as fellow TE Hunter Henry is healthy and available.

metadata.title: Austin Hooper - Held without a catch Monday
metadata.description: Hooper was on the field for 25 of a possible 65 snaps on offense in Monday's 33-15 win over the Giants, per Mike Reiss of ESPN.com.
metadata.analysis: In the process, Hooper, who caught three of his four targets for 39 yards the Patriots' Week 12 win over the Bengals, did not record a target in the contest, while fellow TE Hunter Henry (49 snaps) brought in four of six targets for 73 yards. Hooper heads into his team's bye week with a 16/213/1 receiving line on 19 targets in 12 games, a rate of production that limits his fantasy viability to the deepest of formats.
